stopping_rules.rule: Execute precisely the frozen finite configs once, with their A/A, positive and negative controls; no scaling after inspecting data.
Stop affected computation at declared variable/degree/row/memory cap; preserve UNKNOWN and completed rows.
Certificate mismatch or oracle disagreement invalidates affected scientific comparison; preserve raw record and do not silently rerun.

invalidation_rules: Wrong source/input hash, dropped exceptional branch, rejected positive control, non-reproducible exact output, corrupted certificate, or inconsistent finite-domain model set.

decision_rule.text: For C1-C5 report exact correctness and instrument outcomes separately. A successful correspondence/instrument gate does not support the untested original performance hypothesis. A/A exact invariants must agree; differing operation counts are reported as order sensitivity. Any unresolved branch makes the corresponding completeness/strong-backdoor assertion UNKNOWN.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-cell exact identities, model-set equality, integer counts and cap status; no pooling across distinct lead questions.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Integer differences and paired ratios descriptive only; no extrapolation.

inadmissible: Freeze all fixtures and algorithms before scientific trials; input-only deterministic selection rules are part of fixtures.
All results remain observations until independent review and a committed Coordinator decision.
Retain every mismatch, invalid row, resource-censored row and exceptional branch; no adaptive replacement.
Do not extrapolate finite exact witnesses to cryptographic-size prime groups or a sub-rho attack.
A/A reorders only a declared nuisance factor; positive controls must be detected and negative controls retained.
No clock is a primary metric; operation counts describe these implementations and count setup, selection, failed attempts and checking separately.
Performance hypotheses in the original proposals remain open when only correspondence/instrument gates are evaluated.
A source-inspired construction calibration is not reproduction of a published performance table.

literature.claim: Partial degree-layer source; structured elliptic rank transfer remains unproved.
Multi-homogeneous XL is external motivation, not claimed reproduced by simple block filtering.
Native finite-field conflict explanations; no ECDLP performance transfer.
